behavior.contract: quality_audit schema_version 1, CASEFOLD_LITERAL_TERMS_V1; AVAILABLE or UNAVAILABLE
behavior.consumer: Existing profile-scoped application document-history API and saved resume display
behavior.input: Existing validated saved preview plus recorded generation_context.job_skills; never current job/profile terms

limitations: Literal term appearance is not proof of qualifications, factual truth, ATS success or job fit.
Recorded fingerprint/digest pointers do not independently authenticate stored metadata. Existing explicit target-validation failures are honored.
The UI conservatively displays unavailable when Python full-casefold duplicates cannot be reconciled with JavaScript lowercase (for example Straße/STRASSE).
Legacy or untailored revisions without recorded target terms remain unavailable; no current-job substitution.
No feedback/regeneration pass or before/after regeneration evidence is implemented.
Hosted checks, human review, protected integration and deployment remain pending.
